scenarios.title: Two intruders enter through forced stockroom window
scenarios.hypothesis_summary: two people arrive in a light-coloured van, force the stockroom west window person with the tool a pry bar, and one climbs inside while the other stays at the sill. The inside intruder takes drills from the racking, goes to the office, opens the safe and takes the cash, then passes boxes out through the window for loading into the van before both leave.

supporting_facts.text: CCTV shows two people in dark clothing get out of a light-coloured panel van and walk towards the west wall, one carrying a long object.
CCTV shows them beneath the stockroom window, the window moving inward, and one climbing through feet first while the other stays at the sill.
The window frame was prised open, the lock keep torn out, and a pry bar was left under the window.
Alarm records show stockroom motion, office motion and the safe door opening shortly after the window alarm.
Boxes were handed through the window, carried to the van, the inside person climbed back out, and the van left.
Muddy footwear marks led from the window towards the office, two footwear sizes were found, drills were taken from racking and the safe was empty.

contradicted_points.text: The identities and faces of the two people are not established, and no van number plate was seen.
The cleaner reported hearing a van earlier than the CCTV van arrival, and no camera clock offset was recorded, so the clocks cannot be fully reconciled.
A K02 customer-door unlock was logged before midnight although the alarm was later armed; this account does not explain that earlier door event.
